name: TickHook Self-Hosted Webhook Scheduler
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook scheduler for one-shot and fixed-interval recurring HTTP jobs; no vendor-imposed job quota or software expiry. Redis and compute are user-provided.
watch_out: Requires Redis and self-managed hosting; V1 is single-consumer, at-least-once delivery with no HA or cron expressions, and a documented crash window may lose jobs. Secure the bearer token and account for infrastructure and outbound API costs.
